name: Images
overview: Scripture reveals that humanity is uniquely created in the image and likeness of God, as seen in Genesis 1:26-27, establishing our inherent dignity and responsibility. Christ Himself is described as the perfect image of the invisible God (Colossians 1:15), and believers are called to embody the new man, renewed in righteousness and true holiness (Ephesians 4:24). While God’s image in man reflects His character and authority, the Bible warns against the idolatry of adoring, graven, or worshiping images, emphasizing that true worship is directed to God alone.
